definition: The identity $\cos^{2}\theta + \sin^{2}\theta = 1$, true for every angle $\theta$; it is Pythagoras' theorem for the point $(\cos\theta, \sin\theta)$ on the unit circle.
An identity that writes a ratio of $2\theta$ in terms of ratios of $\theta$, such as $\sin 2\theta = 2\sin\theta\cos\theta$ or $\cos 2\theta = 1 - 2\sin^{2}\theta$.
